scope: Numeric manufacturer MIDI chart extraction across all protocol pages. Per-channel expansions follow explicit decimal channel lists. Ordered CC pairs, mode/shift contexts and feedback are retained. No runnable profile or native HID/display/motor emulation claim. See issues for unnormalized rows.

bindings.encoding: MIDI data byte with source-documented semantics

values.details_source: A linear value corresponding to the speed, from stop to 4X: 64 when stopped, 65(0.06X) - 127(4X) in the forward direction, 63(0.06X) - 0(4X) in the reverse direction.

bindings.mode: MIDI chart; no additional mode specified
notes: Numeric bytes are authoritative over octave names. Source-perspective MIDI-IN means device to host; MIDI-OUT means host to device.
MIDI channel configurable in device utility; no default inferred.
